values.note: 17 drive-in sites and 4 walk-to tent sites (9, 10, 14, 15). Driveways run 15 to 45 ft: 13 drive-in sites are 25 ft or longer; 8, 12 and 16 are 20 ft and 17 is 15 ft. Sites 17 and 19 have been closed since the 2021 Greenwood Fire.

sites.source: RIDB catalog 240957 (sites 1-21; WALK TO 9, 10, 14, 15; 'Driveway Entry: Back-in' on all; Driveway Length 1 45, 3 35, 5 35, 7/11/13/18/20 30, 2/4/6/19/21 25, 8/12/16 20, 17 15) + FS page ('No. of Sites 21') + rec.gov 'campsites 17 and 19 were closed in 2021 due to impacts from the Greenwood Fire and will be closed until further notice', read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: RIDB catalog 240957 (all sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC or WALK TO; 'Water Hookup: No' where listed) + rec.gov notice 'Hose hookups are not permitted.', read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/superior/recreation/mcdougal-lake-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site. Solar powered faucet'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Sites 1, 3, 4, 7, 8, 11, 12 and 16 book on recreation.gov; the rest are first come. Sites 17-21 also take long-term campers May 1 - October 30, reserved by phone with the Tofte Ranger District.

booking.source: RIDB catalog 240957 (reservable: 1, 3, 4, 7, 8, 11, 12, 16) + rec.gov '13 first come, first served and 8 reservable campsites', rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, notice 'Sites #17-21 are available for long term seasonal camping from May 1 to October 30 ... Contact the Tofte Ranger District Office at 218-663-8060 to reserve long term sites.', read 2026-11-11

values.note: Long-term sites 17-21: $504 a season or for any stay over two weeks. An extra vehicle pays half the site fee; one towed vehicle such as a boat trailer is included.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/superior/recreation/mcdougal-lake-campground ('Single Site: $18 per night; $504 per season'; 'Maximum of nine people per site. There is space for one vehicle and one towed vehicle (such as a boat trailer). Additional vehicles on the site require additional half fee') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/240957/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-08..09-30 and 2027-05-12..09-30: PeakStandard 18), read 2026-11-11

note: Campground in birch, maple and pine beside 323-acre McDougal Lake (wild rice, walleye and northern pike), 10 mi W of Isabella on FR 106, with a sandy swim beach and a boat ramp. Sites are separated by woods; the Forest Service says the spurs are not designed for RVs and some may not suit one. The hiking trail has been closed since the 2021 Greenwood Fire. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov/RIDB read: 21 sites (17 drive-in, 4 walk-to tent), driveways 15-45 ft with 13 drive-in sites 25 ft+, 8 reservable, 17/19 closed since the 2021 fire, 17-21 long-term $504, $18 in 2026 and 2027, half-fee extra vehicle, 9 people, 14 nights, vault toilets + solar-pump water, May 8 - Oct 1. Not waterfront kept. Not in the post-wildfire closure order.
flags: SITES max_rig_ft 24 (derived from old note) -> 45 (RIDB Driveway Length of site 1; no Max Vehicle Length is posted). 13 of 17 drive-in sites have driveways of 25 ft or more; of the 8 reservable sites, 1, 3, 4, 7 and 11 are 25 ft+, while 8, 12 and 16 are 20 ft.

CATALOG vs prose: FS/rec.gov say the RV sites are 'pull-in'; RIDB types every site 'Back-in'. pull_through false from the catalog. 'Not specifically designed for RVs' is Superior NF boilerplate (also on Little Isabella and Ninemile), not a drop.

PARTIAL CLOSURE: rec.gov 'campsites 17 and 19 were closed in 2021 due to impacts from the Greenwood Fire and will be closed until further notice' (and the hiking trail). Campground itself open in season; recorded in sites.note and the entry note, not status.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: on Esri imagery the nearest drive-in site points (12 at 47.63719,-91.53418, driveway 20 ft; 11 at 47.63724,-91.53510) are about 30-45 m from the south bay through continuous forest; site 7 is ~75 m from the marshy west shore. No open ground to the water; the shore opening is the beach/boat-ramp day-use area. No change.
Pin 47.63920,-91.53380 is ~110 m NE of the site centroid 47.63850,-91.53493, on the campground road by site 1. No move.
PHONE 218-663-8060 confirmed (Tofte Ranger District). Websites current. Status: FS 'Closed-No fees or services' is the ordinary end of season; not in post-wildfire closure order 09-09-00-26-11.

EQUIPMENT: RIDB permitted equipment on these sites lists only tents and 'VEHICLE' (no RV, trailer or fifth-wheel type), so the Availability page's EKKO filter will show no site here. FS still lists the sites under 'RV Camping' and the driveways run to 45 ft; same Superior NF pattern as Little Isabella and Ninemile.
